title: Think-to-Personalize: Unifying Reasoning and Retrieval for User-Centric Personalized Dense Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2608.18855v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Dense retrieval has become a cornerstone of modern local-lifestyle e-commerce search by encoding queries and items into semantic embedding spaces. While recent advancements have transitioned from BERT-based embedding models to Large Language Models (LLMs), most approaches still treat LLMs as static text encoders, neglecting their inherent reasoning capabilities. Furthermore, standard dense retrieval models remain query-centric, which is insufficient in e-commerce scenarios where sparse and ambiguous queries create an intent gap that can only be bridged by the rich context of user history. translated_title: 思考至个性化：统一推理与检索以实现用户中心的个性化稠密检索
translated_abstract: 稠密检索通过将查询和物品编码到语义嵌入空间中，已成为现代本地生活电商搜索的基石。尽管最近的进展已从基于BERT的嵌入模型转向大型语言模型（LLMs），但大多数方法仍将LLMs视为静态文本编码器，忽略了其固有的推理能力。此外，标准稠密检索模型保持查询中心，这在电商场景中不足，因为稀疏和模糊的查询会产生意图差距，只能通过用户历史的丰富上下文来弥合。同时，现有的个性化检索方法通常依赖隐式嵌入交互，缺乏从噪声历史行为中有效消除用户意图歧义的推理能力。为解决这些挑战，我们提出了“思考至个性化”（TTP），一种新颖的框架，将显式的用户中心意图推理与稠密检索统一起来。
tldr: 本论文提出TTP框架，通过结合显式用户意图推理与稠密检索，解决了电商中模糊查询和噪声历史导致的个性化检索难题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the TTP framework, which unifies explicit user-centric intent reasoning with dense retrieval to address the challenge of personalized search under ambiguous queries and noisy user history in e-commerce.
